challenges.title: Recall checkpoint

challenges.hint: Use “Scope” as a cue, then close the lesson again.

challenges.title: Prediction checkpoint
challenges.prompt: Choose one example or source file from this mission. Predict its behavior for a normal input and a changed or invalid input before running or revealing the reference. Explain the rule separating the outcomes.
challenges.hint: Change one condition at a time so the result teaches a rule.

files.content:
# Threat Model Workbook

## Scope

Describe the version and environment being modeled. List explicit non-goals.

## Assets

- Password-derived credentials and active sessions
- User identity and board membership
- Private board/card content
- Availability and integrity of activity history
- Deployment/database credentials
- Logs and backups

## Trust boundaries

Mark where untrusted data crosses into the browser, API, realtime connection,
background worker, database, logging system, and third-party providers.

## Threat table

| Threat | Entry point | Impact | Existing control | Test/evidence | Remaining risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Credential stuffing | Login | Account access | | | |
| Session theft | Browser/network/log | Account access | | | |
| Cross-user ID substitution | API route/body | Private data exposure | | | |
| CSRF | Browser session | Unauthorized mutation | | | |
| Stored XSS | Card content | Session/data compromise | | | |
| SQL injection | Query/filter input | Data compromise | | | |
| Realtime subscription bypass | Socket connect/message | Private event exposure | | | |
| Replay/duplicate mutation | HTTP/offline queue | Duplicate effects | | | |
| Log injection/secret leakage | All inputs | Operational/security harm | | | |
| Resource exhaustion | Auth, search, sockets | Availability | | | |

## Required abuse tests

- Replace a board/card ID with another user's valid ID.
- Connect directly to another board's realtime channel.
- Reuse an idempotency key with changed input.
- Submit oversized, malformed, and deeply nested payloads.
- Put HTML/script-like content in every user text field.
- Trigger repeated failed logins and reconnect storms.
- Logout, then replay the old session.
- Search captured logs for seeded fake secrets.

## Review trigger

Update this model when authentication, authorization, data classification,
external integrations, deployment topology, or trust boundaries change.
